business_summary: China Satellite Communications Co., Ltd. provides satellite communications and broadcasting services. It offers business support platforms, including visualized platform to support design, simulation, and evaluation on satellite resources and satellite application; multi-satellite unified tracking, telemetry, and control (TT&C) platform; traditional beam comprehensive service; carrier grade satellite broadband business and operation infrastructure platform; and satellite application platforms for airborne, maritime, emergency response, and universal services. The company also provides long-term and temporary rental services of satellite resources; TT&C, consulting for satellites and related applications, training, network access testing and antenna certification, and geosynchronous orbit communication satellite interference positioning services; bandwidth rental services for TV channels distribution, contribution and direct-to-home broadcast through satellites; and OU services to transmit radio and television programs. In addition, it offers leasing services for space segments; uplink service, HUB hosting and operation, and other teleport services; information services, such as remote sensing images, and location and weather information; consultation, certification, training, advertising, and other related services; and integrated information services in land, sea, and air for sensing and transmission. Further, the company provides emergency communications; private network communication network; universal services based on satellite communication; E-education; telecommunication services; satellite-based IoT solutions; streaming media, audio and video transmission, and live broadcasting; smart monitoring and early warning services; and services for marine and airborne applications. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China. China Satellite Communications Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation.
business_summary_ko: China Satellite Communications Co., Ltd.는 위성 통신 및 방송 서비스를 제공합니다. 위성 자원 및 위성 응용에 대한 설계, 시뮬레이션 및 평가를 지원하는 시각화된 플랫폼을 포함한 비즈니스 지원 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 다중 위성 통합 추적, 원격 측정 및 제어(TT&C) 플랫폼; 전통적인 빔 종합 서비스; 캐리어 등급 위성 광대역 사업 및 운영 인프라 플랫폼; 항공, 해상, 비상 대응 및 보편적 서비스를 위한 위성 애플리케이션 플랫폼. 회사는 또한 위성 자원의 장기 및 임시 임대 서비스를 제공합니다. TT&C, 위성 및 관련 애플리케이션 컨설팅, 교육, 네트워크 액세스 테스트 및 안테나 인증, 정지궤도 통신 위성 간섭 포지셔닝 서비스 TV 채널 배포, 제공 및 위성을 통한 가정 방송을 위한 대역폭 임대 서비스; 라디오 및 TV 프로그램을 전송하는 OU 서비스. 또한 우주 부문에 대한 임대 서비스도 제공합니다. 업링크 서비스, HUB 호스팅 및 운영, 기타 텔레포트 서비스; rem과 같은 정보 서비스
